gocchakas.name: Hetu Gocchaka
gocchakas.description: The cluster of 6 dyads dealing with hetu (roots: lobha, dosa, moha, alobha, adosa, amoha) and their relations with consciousness, mental factors, matter, and Nibbāna.

padas.dabbattha: Lobha, dosa, moha, alobha, adosa, amoha
padas.cetasikas: 6 hetus (lobha, dosa, moha, alobha, adosa, amoha)
padas.explanation: Only the six root cetasikas themselves qualify as hetu: 3 unwholesome (lobha, dosa, moha) and 3 beautiful (alobha, adosa, amoha).

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, their associated 46 cetasikas (excluding 6 hetus), 28 rūpa, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All conditioned realities other than the 6 roots, plus unconditioned Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Sahetu duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Root-accompanied and Rootless states

padas.dabbattha: 71 sahetuka cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas (excluding moha in two mohamūla cittas)
padas.cetasikas: 52 cetasikas (excluding moha in the 2 mohamūla cittas)
padas.explanation: States co-arising with at least one root. Moha in the 2 mohamūla cittas is excluded because it is the sole root therein and cannot accompany itself.

padas.dabbattha: 18 ahetuka cittas, their associated 12 cetasikas (excluding chanda), moha in two mohamūla cittas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.cetasikas: 12 cetasikas (excluding chanda) + moha in 2 mohamūla cittas
padas.explanation: All dhammas devoid of an accompanying root, including rootless consciousness, solitary moha, matter, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Hetusampayutta duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Root-conjoined and Root-disjoined states

padas.dabbattha: 71 sahetuka cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas (excluding moha in 2 mohamūla cittas)
padas.explanation: States conjoined with roots by sharing the four characteristics of mental association.

padas.dabbattha: 18 ahetuka cittas, their associated 12 cetasikas (excluding chanda), moha in 2 mohamūla cittas, 28 rūpa, Nibbāna
padas.cetasikas: 12 cetasikas (excluding chanda) + moha in 2 mohamūla cittas
padas.explanation: States not conjoined with any root: 18 ahetuka cittas, solitary moha, matter, and Nibbāna.

padas.paliTranslation: States that are both roots and accompanied by roots
padas.dabbattha: 6 hetus (excluding moha in 2 mohamūla cittas)
padas.cetasikas: 6 hetus (excluding solitary moha in 2 mohamūla cittas)
padas.explanation: Roots that co-exist with a companion root in two-root and three-root cittas.

padas.pada: Sahetukā ceva dhammā na ca hetū
padas.paliTranslation: States that are accompanied by roots but are not roots
padas.dabbattha: 71 sahetuka cittas, their associated 46 cetasikas (excluding 6 hetus)
padas.explanation: Non-root mental dhammas that arise accompanied by root cetasikas.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 18 ahetuka cittas, their associated 12 cetasikas (excluding chanda), moha in two mohamūla cittas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
dukamuttaka.explanation: States that are entirely unaccompanied by roots fall outside both padas.

padas.paliTranslation: States that are roots and associated with roots
padas.dabbattha: 6 hetus (excluding moha in 2 mohamūla cittas)
padas.explanation: Roots associated with co-arising companion roots.

padas.paliTranslation: States associated with roots but are not roots
padas.dabbattha: 71 sahetuka cittas, their associated 46 cetasikas (excluding 6 hetus)
padas.explanation: Sahetuka consciousness and non-root cetasikas associated with roots.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 18 ahetuka cittas, their associated 12 cetasikas (excluding chanda), moha in 2 mohamūla cittas, 28 rūpa, Nibbāna
dukamuttaka.explanation: States dissociated from roots cannot be included in either pada.

dukas.name: Na hetu sahetuka duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Non-root accompanied vs Non-root rootless

padas.pada: Na hetū kho pana dhammā sahetukāpi
padas.paliTranslation: States that are not roots, but are accompanied by roots
padas.dabbattha: 71 sahetuka cittas, their associated 46 cetasikas (excluding 6 hetus)
padas.explanation: Sahetuka cittas and non-root cetasikas.

padas.pada: Na hetū kho pana dhammā ahetukāpi
padas.paliTranslation: States that are not roots, and are unaccompanied by roots
padas.dabbattha: 18 ahetuka cittas, their associated 12 cetasikas (excluding chanda), 28 rūpa, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Rootless non-roots. Moha in 2 mohamūla cittas is excluded because it is a root.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: Lobha, dosa, moha, alobha, adosa, amoha
dukamuttaka.explanation: All 6 roots are excluded by the prefix 'Na hetū'.

gocchakas.name: Cūlantara Duka
gocchakas.description: The cluster of 7 minor intermediate dyads classifying dhammas by conditions, conditioned nature, visibility, impingement, physical form, worldliness, and cognizability.

dukas.name: Sappaccaya duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Conditioned (by causes) and Unconditioned

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: All mundane and supramundane conditioned phenomena generated by kamma, citta, utu, and āhāra.

padas.dabbattha: Nibbāna
padas.explanation: The unconditioned element (Asaṅkhata dhātu), independent of conditions.

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: All phenomena characterized by arising (uppāda), passing away (vaya), and alteration of that which stands (ṭhitassa aññathatta).

padas.dabbattha: Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Nibbāna, which has no arising, vanishing, or modification.

padas.dabbattha: Rūpāyatana (vaṇṇa rūpa)
padas.explanation: Only color/visible form (vaṇṇa rūpa) can be seen with the eye.

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 27 rūpas (excluding rūpāyatana/vaṇṇa rūpa), Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All other physical, mental, and unconditioned realities cannot be seen with visual consciousness.

padas.dabbattha: 12 oḷārika rūpas (5 pasāda rūpas, 7 gocara rūpas)
padas.rupa: 12 gross rūpas (5 sensitive bases, 7 sense fields)
padas.explanation: Gross matter capable of mutual sensory contact or physical impingement.

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 16 sukhuma rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Non-impinging states: subtle physical form, all mental states, and Nibbāna.

padas.dabbattha: 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: All 28 material phenomena (4 great essentials + 24 derived matter).

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All consciousness, mental concomitants, and Nibbāna.

padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: Phenomena connected to the worlds of sense desire, fine material, and immaterial existence.

padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Transcendent path and fruition consciousness with associated cetasikas, plus Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Kenaci viññeyya duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Cognizable by some vs Not cognizable by some

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All four ultimate realities can be known by appropriate types of knowledge (e.g. Omniscience).

padas.paliTranslation: States not cognizable by some knowledge
padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All four ultimate realities also cannot be completely known by ordinary or inferior knowledges (such as eye consciousness knowing mental factors).

gocchakas.name: Āsava Gocchaka
gocchakas.description: The cluster of 6 dyads dealing with āsava (cankers/taints: lobha, diṭṭhi, moha) and their relations with consciousness and ultimate realities.

padas.dabbattha: Lobha, diṭṭhi, moha
padas.explanation: The 4 cankers (kāma, bhava, diṭṭhi, avijjā) reduce to 3 cetasikas: lobha, diṭṭhi, and moha.

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, their associated 49 cetasikas (excluding 3 āsavas), 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All ultimate realities other than the 3 canker cetasikas.

dukas.name: Sāsava duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Taint-prone and Taint-free states

padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: Mundane dhammas that serve as objects of the cankers.

padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Supramundane cittas, their cetasikas, and Nibbāna.

padas.dabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, their associated 27 cetasikas (excluding moha in 2 dosamūla cittas and 2 mohamūla cittas)
padas.cetasikas: 27 cetasikas (excluding solitary moha in 2 dosamūla and 2 mohamūla cittas)
padas.explanation: Akusala states associated with at least one āsava. Moha in dosamūla and mohamūla cittas is solitary as an āsava and cannot associate with itself.

padas.dabbattha: 21 kusala cittas, 36 vipāka cittas, 20 kiriya cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, moha in 2 dosamūla cittas and 2 mohamūla cittas, rūpa 28, Nibbāna
padas.cetasikas: 38 cetasikas + moha in 2 dosamūla and 2 mohamūla cittas
padas.explanation: Wholesome, resultant, functional dhammas, solitary moha in dosamūla/mohamūla, matter, and Nibbāna.

padas.paliTranslation: States that are both cankers and subject to cankers
padas.dabbattha: 3 āsavas (lobha, diṭṭhi, moha)
padas.explanation: The 3 canker cetasikas themselves are inherently mundane and subject to being canker objects.

padas.pada: Sāsavā ceva dhammā no ca āsavā
padas.paliTranslation: States that are subject to cankers but not cankers
padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 49 (excluding 3 āsavas), 28 rūpa
padas.explanation: All mundane dhammas excluding the 3 āsava cetasikas.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
dukamuttaka.explanation: Supramundane states are free from cankers and cannot be categorized under sāsava.

padas.paliTranslation: States that are cankers and associated with cankers
padas.dabbattha: 3 āsavas (excluding moha in 2 dosamūla cittas and 2 mohamūla cittas)
padas.cetasikas: Lobha, diṭṭhi, and moha (where accompanying another āsava)
padas.explanation: Āsavas that co-arise with another āsava (e.g. lobha and moha, or lobha, diṭṭhi, and moha).

padas.pada: Āsavasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca āsavā
padas.paliTranslation: States that are associated with cankers but are not cankers
padas.dabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, their associated 24 cetasikas (excluding 3 āsavas)
padas.explanation: The 12 unwholesome consciousnesses and remaining non-āsava cetasikas associated with āsavas.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 21 kusala cittas, 36 vipāka cittas, 20 kiriya cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, moha in 2 dosamūla cittas and 2 mohamūla cittas, rūpa 28, Nibbāna
dukamuttaka.explanation: States dissociated from cankers fall outside both padas.

padas.paliTranslation: States dissociated from cankers but subject to cankers
padas.dabbattha: 17 lokiya kusala cittas, 32 lokiya vipāka cittas, 20 kiriya cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, moha in 2 dosamūla cittas and 2 mohamūla cittas, 28 rūpas
padas.cittas: 69 mundane cittas (17 lokiya kusala + 32 lokiya vipāka + 20 kiriya)
padas.cetasikas: 38 cetasikas + moha in 2 dosamūla and 2 mohamūla cittas
padas.explanation: Mundane states that are dissociated from cankers.

padas.paliTranslation: States dissociated from cankers and free from cankers
padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Supramundane consciousness, supramundane cetasikas, and unconditioned Nibbāna.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, their associated 27 cetasikas (excluding moha in 2 dosamūla cittas and 2 mohamūla cittas)
dukamuttaka.explanation: Canker-conjoined states cannot enter padas defined as āsavavippayutta.

gocchakas.name: Saṃyojana Gocchaka
gocchakas.description: The cluster of 6 dyads dealing with the 8 or 10 fetters (lobha, dosa, māna, diṭṭhi, vicikicchā, issā, macchariya, moha) and their relations with consciousness and realities.

padas.dabbattha: Lobha, dosa, māna, diṭṭhi, vicikicchā, isssā, macchariya, moha
padas.cetasikas: 8 cetasikas (lobha, dosa, māna, diṭṭhi, vicikicchā, issā, macchariya, moha)
padas.explanation: The 8 cetasika realities that function as the ten fetters binding beings to saṃsāra.

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, their associated 44 cetasikas (excluding 8 saṃyojanas), 28 rūpa, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All other states apart from the 8 fetters.

dukas.name: Saṃyojaniya duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Favourable to fetters and Unfavourable to fetters

padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: All mundane dhammas that can become objects of fettering.

padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Supramundane cittas, cetasikas, and Nibbāna.

padas.dabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, their associated 27 cetasikas (excluding moha in uddhacca sampayutta citta)
padas.cetasikas: 27 cetasikas (excluding solitary moha in uddhaccasampayutta citta)
padas.explanation: Akusala states associated with at least one fetter. In uddhacca-sampayutta citta, moha is solitary as a fetter and cannot associate with itself.

padas.dabbattha: 21 kusala cittas, 36 vipāka cittas, 20 kiriya cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, moha in uddhacca sampayutta citta, 28 rūpa, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Kusala, vipāka, kiriya, solitary moha in uddhacca citta, rūpa, and Nibbāna.

padas.paliTranslation: States that are fetters and favourable to fetters
padas.dabbattha: 8 saṃyojanas
padas.explanation: The 8 fetter cetasikas are themselves mundane objects of clinging.

padas.pada: Saṃyojaniyā ceva dhammā no ca saṃyojanā
padas.paliTranslation: States favourable to fetters but not fetters
padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 44 cetasikas (excluding 8 saṃyojanas), 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: All mundane consciousness, remaining cetasikas, and physical matter.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
dukamuttaka.explanation: Supramundane states are completely beyond being objects of fettering.

padas.paliTranslation: States that are fetters and associated with fetters
padas.dabbattha: 8 saṃyojanas (excluding moha in uddhacca sampayutta citta)
padas.cetasikas: 8 saṃyojanas (excluding solitary moha in uddhacca citta)
padas.explanation: The fetter cetasikas that co-arise with another fetter.

padas.pada: Saṃyojanasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca saṃyojanā
padas.paliTranslation: States associated with fetters but not fetters
padas.dabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, their associated 19 cetasikas (excluding 8 saṃyojanas)
padas.explanation: Unwholesome consciousness and the non-fetter unwholesome cetasikas.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 21 kusala cittas, 36 vipāka cittas, 20 kiriya cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, moha in uddhacca sampayutta citta, 28 rūpa, Nibbāna
dukamuttaka.explanation: States dissociated from fetters fall outside both padas.

padas.paliTranslation: States dissociated from fetters but favourable to fetters
padas.dabbattha: 17 lokiya kusala cittas, 32 lokiya vipāka cittas, 20 kiriya cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, moha in uddhacca sampayutta citta, 28 rūpa
padas.cetasikas: 38 cetasikas + solitary moha in uddhacca citta
padas.explanation: Mundane states that are dissociated from fetters.

padas.paliTranslation: States dissociated from fetters and not favourable to fetters
padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Supramundane consciousness, cetasikas, and unconditioned Nibbāna.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, their associated 27 cetasikas (excluding moha in uddhacca sampayutta citta)
dukamuttaka.explanation: States conjoined with fetters cannot enter padas requiring saṃyojanavippayutta.

gocchakas.name: Gantha Gocchaka
gocchakas.description: The cluster of 6 dyads dealing with the 4 ties (gantha: abhijjhyā, byāpāda, sīlabbataparāmāsa, idaṃsaccābhinivesa) which comprise 3 cetasikas (lobha, diṭṭhi, dosa).

padas.dabbattha: Lobha, diṭṭhi, dosa
padas.explanation: The 4 ties reduce to 3 cetasikas: covetousness (lobha), ill-will (dosa), and wrong view (diṭṭhi: clinging to rules and misapprehension of truth).

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, their associated 49 cetasikas (excluding 3 ganthas), 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All other states besides the 3 ties.

padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: All mundane phenomena.

padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Supramundane consciousness, supramundane cetasikas, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Ganthasampayutta duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Conjoined with ties and Disjoined from ties

padas.dabbattha: 8 lobhamūla cittas, 2 dosamūla cittas, their associated 25 cetasikas (excluding dosa, vicikicchā, lobha in 4 lobhamūla diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas)
padas.cetasikas: 25 cetasikas (excluding dosa, vicikicchā, and lobha in 4 diṭṭhigata-vippayutta cittas)
padas.explanation: States associated with at least one tie. Dosa in 2 dosamūla cittas is the solitary tie therein, as is lobha in the 4 diṭṭhigata-vippayutta lobha cittas.

padas.dabbattha: 2 mohamūla cittas, 21 kusala cittas, 36 vipāka cittas, 20 kiriya cittas, their associated 43 cetasikas (excluding lobhādi tika, dosādi catukka, 2 thīnamiddha), dosa in two dosamūla cittas, lobha in 4 lobhamūla diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas, 28 rūpa, Nibbāna
padas.cetasikas: 43 cetasikas + solitary dosa and lobha mentioned
padas.explanation: All remaining states dissociated from ties.

padas.paliTranslation: States that are ties and favourable to ties
padas.dabbattha: 3 ganthas (lobha, diṭṭhi, dosa)
padas.explanation: The 3 tie cetasikas.

padas.pada: Ganthaniyā ceva dhammā no ca ganthā
padas.paliTranslation: States favourable to ties but not ties
padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 49 cetasikas (excluding 3 ganthas), 28 rūpa
padas.explanation: Mundane consciousness, non-tie cetasikas, and matter.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna

padas.paliTranslation: States that are ties and associated with ties
padas.dabbattha: Lobha in 4 diṭṭhigata sampayutta cittas and diṭṭhi
padas.cetasikas: Lobha and diṭṭhi in the 4 diṭṭhigata-sampayutta cittas
padas.explanation: Lobha and diṭṭhi co-arising together are both ties and mutual associates of a tie.

padas.pada: Ganthasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca ganthā
padas.paliTranslation: States associated with ties but not ties
padas.dabbattha: 8 lobhamūla cittas, 2 dosamūla cittas, their associated 23 cetasikas (excluding lobha, diṭṭhi, dosa, vicikichā)
padas.explanation: The 10 cittas and non-tie cetasikas occurring in tie-conjoined consciousness.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 2 mohamūla cittas, 21 kusala cittas, 36 vipāka cittas, 20 kiriya cittas, their associated 43 cetasikas (excluding lobhādi tika, dosādi catukka, 2 thīnamiddha), dosa in two dosamūla cittas, lobha in 4 lobhamūla diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas, 28 rūpa, Nibbāna

padas.paliTranslation: States dissociated from ties but favourable to ties
padas.dabbattha: 2 mohamūla cittas, 17 lokiya kusala cittas, 32 lokiya vipāka cittas, 20 kiriya cittas, their associated 43 cetasikas (excluding lobhādi tika, dosādi catukka, 2 thīnamiddha), dosa in two dosamūla cittas, lobha in 4 lobhamūla diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas, 28 rūpa
padas.explanation: Mundane states dissociated from ties.

padas.paliTranslation: States dissociated from ties and not favourable to ties
padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Supramundane consciousness, cetasikas, and unconditioned Nibbāna.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 8 lobhamūla cittas, 2 dosamūla cittas, their associated 25 cetasikas (excluding dosa, vicikicchā, lobha in 4 lobhamūla diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas)

gocchakas.name: Ogha Gocchaka
gocchakas.description: The cluster of 6 dyads dealing with the 4 floods (ogha: kāmogha, bhavogha, diṭṭhogha, avijjogha) comprising lobha, diṭṭhi, and moha.

padas.dabbattha: Lobha, diṭṭhi, moha
padas.explanation: The 4 floods sweeping beings down into the ocean of saṃsāra comprise lobha, diṭṭhi, and moha.

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, their associated 49 cetasikas (excluding 3 oghas), 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All other states besides the 3 floods.

padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: Mundane realities that can be overwhelmed by floods.

padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Supramundane consciousness, cetasikas, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Oghasampayutta duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Conjoined with floods and Disjoined from floods

padas.dabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, their associated 27 cetasikas (excluding moha in 2 dosamūla cittas and 2 mohamūla cittas)
padas.cetasikas: 27 cetasikas (excluding moha in 2 dosamūla cittas and 2 mohamūla cittas)
padas.explanation: Akusala states associated with at least one flood factor.

padas.dabbattha: 21 kusala cittas, 36 vipāka cittas, 20 kiriya cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, moha in 2 dosamūla cittas and 2 mohamūla cittas, rūpa 28, Nibbāna
padas.cetasikas: 38 cetasikas + solitary moha in dosamūla and mohamūla cittas
padas.explanation: All states dissociated from floods.

padas.paliTranslation: States that are floods and subject to floods
padas.dabbattha: 3 oghas (lobha, diṭṭhi, moha)
padas.explanation: The 3 flood cetasikas are themselves mundane phenomena.

padas.pada: Oghaniyā ceva dhammā no ca oghā
padas.paliTranslation: States subject to floods but not floods
padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 49 (excluding 3 oghas), 28 rūpa
padas.explanation: Mundane consciousness, non-flood cetasikas, and matter.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna

padas.paliTranslation: States that are floods and associated with floods
padas.dabbattha: 3 oghas (excluding moha in 2 dosamūla cittas and 2 mohamūla cittas)
padas.cetasikas: 3 oghas (excluding solitary moha in dosamūla and mohamūla cittas)
padas.explanation: Floods accompanied by another flood.

padas.pada: Oghasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca oghā
padas.paliTranslation: States associated with floods but not floods

padas.paliTranslation: States dissociated from floods but subject to floods
padas.dabbattha: 17 lokiya kusala cittas, 32 lokiya vipāka cittas, 20 kiriya cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, moha in 2 dosamūla cittas and 2 mohamūla cittas, 28 rūpas

padas.explanation: Mundane dhammas dissociated from floods.

padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna

gocchakas.name: Yoga Gocchaka
gocchakas.description: The cluster of 6 dyads dealing with the 4 yokes (yoga: kāmayoga, bhavayoga, diṭṭhiyoga, avijjāyoga) comprising lobha, diṭṭhi, and moha.

padas.dabbattha: Lobha, diṭṭhi, moha

padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas

padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Supramundane consciousness, cetasikas, and unconditioned Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Yogasampayutta duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Conjoined with yokes and Disjoined from yokes

padas.dabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, their associated 27 cetasikas (excluding moha in 2 dosamūla cittas and 2 mohamūla cittas)
padas.cetasikas: 27 cetasikas (excluding moha in 2 dosamūla cittas and 2 mohamūla cittas)

padas.paliTranslation: States that are yokes and subject to yokes

padas.explanation: The 3 yoke cetasikas themselves.

padas.pada: Yoganiyā ceva dhammā no ca yogā
padas.paliTranslation: States subject to yokes but not yokes
padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 49 (excluding 3 yogas), 28 rūpa
padas.explanation: Mundane consciousness, non-yoke cetasikas, and physical matter.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna

padas.paliTranslation: States that are yokes and associated with yokes
padas.dabbattha: 3 yogas (excluding moha in 2 dosamūla cittas and 2 mohamūla cittas)
padas.cetasikas: 3 yogas (excluding solitary moha in dosamūla and mohamūla cittas)
padas.explanation: Yokes that co-arise with another yoke.

padas.pada: Yogasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca yogā
padas.paliTranslation: States associated with yokes but not yokes
padas.dabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, their associated 24 cetasikas (excluding 3 yogas)
padas.explanation: The 12 akusala cittas and non-yoke cetasikas associated with yokes.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 21 kusala cittas, 36 vipāka cittas, 20 kiriya cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, moha in 2 dosamūla cittas and 2 mohamūla cittas, rūpa 28, Nibbāna

padas.paliTranslation: States dissociated from yokes but subject to yokes
padas.dabbattha: 17 lokiya kusala cittas, 32 lokiya vipāka cittas, 20 kiriya cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, moha in 2 dosamūla cittas and 2 mohamūla cittas, 28 rūpas
padas.cetasikas: 38 cetasikas + solitary moha in dosamūla and mohamūla cittas
padas.explanation: Mundane dhammas dissociated from yokes.

padas.explanation: Supramundane consciousness, cetasikas, and unconditioned Nibbāna.

gocchakas.name: Nīvara Gocchaka
gocchakas.description: The cluster of 6 dyads dealing with the hindrances (nīvaraṇa: lobha, dosa, thīna, middha, uddhacca, kukkucca, vicikicchā, moha) obstructing mental clarity and jhana.

padas.dabbattha: Lobha, dosa, thīna, middha, uddhacca, kukkucca, vicikicchā, moha
padas.cetasikas: 8 cetasikas (lobha, dosa, thīna, middha, uddhacca, kukkucca, vicikicchā, moha)
padas.explanation: The 8 cetasikas constituting the hindrance factors.

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, their associated 44 cetasikas (excluding the 8 nīvaraṇas), 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All other states apart from the 8 hindrance cetasikas.

padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas

padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Supramundane cittas, cetasikas, and unconditioned Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Nīvaraṇasampayutta duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Conjoined with hindrances and Disjoined from hindrances

padas.dabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, their associated 27 cetasikas
padas.explanation: All 12 unwholesome consciousnesses and all 27 unwholesome cetasikas (every akusala citta has uddhacca and moha, so all are hindrance-conjoined).

padas.dabbattha: 21 kusala cittas, 36 vipāka cittas, 20 kiriyā cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All wholesome, resultant, functional cittas, associated cetasikas, matter, and Nibbāna.

padas.paliTranslation: States that are hindrances and subject to hindrances
padas.dabbattha: 8 nīvaraṇas (lobha, dosa, thīna, middha, uddhacca, kukkucca, vicikicchā, moha)
padas.explanation: The 8 hindrance cetasikas themselves.

padas.pada: Nīvaraṇiyā ceva dhammā no ca nīvaraṇā
padas.paliTranslation: States subject to hindrances but not hindrances
padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 44 cetasikas (excluding the 8 nīvaraṇas), 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: All mundane consciousness, remaining cetasikas, and physical matter.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna

padas.paliTranslation: States that are hindrances and associated with hindrances
padas.dabbattha: 8 nīvaraṇas (lobha, dosa, thīna, middha, uddhacca, kukkucca, vicikicchā, moha)
padas.explanation: Every hindrance co-arises with at least one other hindrance (moha and uddhacca are universally present in all akusala).

padas.pada: Nīvaraṇasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca nīvaraṇā
padas.paliTranslation: States associated with hindrances but not hindrances
padas.dabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, their associated 19 cetasikas (excluding the 8 nīvaraṇas)
padas.explanation: The 12 akusala cittas and non-hindrance unwholesome cetasikas.

padas.dabbattha: 17 lokiya kusala cittas, 32 lokiya vipāka cittas, 20 kiriyā cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, 28 rūpas

padas.paliTranslation: States dissociated from hindrances and not subject to hindrances

gocchakas.name: Parāmāsa Gocchaka
gocchakas.description: The cluster of dyads dealing with misapprehension/dogmatism (parāmāsa = diṭṭhi) and its relations with consciousness and realities.

padas.dabbattha: Diṭṭhi
padas.explanation: Only the wrong-view cetasika (diṭṭhi) itself is called parāmāsa.

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, their associated 51 cetasikas (excluding diṭṭhi), 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All other states besides diṭṭhi.

dukas.name: Parāmaṭṭha duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Misapprehended (clung to as 'mine'/'self') and Not-misapprehended

padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: Mundane phenomena that can be grasped by wrong view.

padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Supramundane consciousness, cetasikas, and unconditioned Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Parāmāsasampayutta duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Conjoined with misapprehension and Disjoined from misapprehension

padas.dabbattha: 4 lobhamūla diṭṭhigata sampayutta cittas, their associated 20 cetasikas (excluding diṭṭhi, māna, dosacatukka and vicikicchā)
padas.explanation: The cittas and mental factors co-arising with diṭṭhi (excluding diṭṭhi itself, since a dhamma cannot associate with itself).

padas.dabbattha: 4 lobhamūla diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas, 2 dosamūla cittas, 2 mohamūla cittas, 21 kusala cittas, 36 vipāka cittas, 20 kiriyā cittas, their associated 51 cetasikas (excluding diṭṭhi), 28 rūpas, Nibbāna

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: Diṭṭhi cetasika
dukamuttaka.explanation: Diṭṭhi itself is not parāmāsasampayutta (cannot associate with itself) and cannot be classed as parāmāsavippayutta since it is the very parāmāsa.

padas.paliTranslation: States that are misapprehensions and subject to misapprehension
padas.dabbattha: Diṭṭhi
padas.explanation: Diṭṭhi itself is mundane and subject to being misapprehended.

padas.pada: Parāmaṭṭhā ceva dhammā no ca parāmāsā
padas.paliTranslation: States subject to misapprehension but not misapprehensions
padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 51 cetasikas (excluding diṭṭhi), 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: Mundane cittas, remaining cetasikas, and physical matter.

padas.explanation: Mundane phenomena dissociated from diṭṭhi.

padas.paliTranslation: States dissociated from misapprehension and not subject to misapprehension
padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Supramundane consciousness, cetasikas, and unconditioned Nibbāna.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 4 lobhamūla diṭṭhigata-sampayutta cittas, their associated 21 cetasikas, and diṭṭhi

gocchakas.name: Mahantara Duka
gocchakas.description: The cluster of 14 great intermediate dyads dealing with objects, mind, mental concomitants, origination, co-existence, succession, internal/external, clung-to, and derived matter.

dukas.name: Sārammaṇa duka

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas
padas.explanation: All mental states (nāma) necessarily cognize an object.

padas.dabbattha: 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Physical form and Nibbāna do not cognize objects.

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas
padas.explanation: All 89 consciousnesses.

padas.dabbattha: 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Mental factors, material phenomena, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Cetasika duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Mental factors and Non-mental factors

padas.dabbattha: 52 cetasikas
padas.explanation: The 52 mental concomitants.

padas.paliTranslation: States that are not mental factors
padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Consciousness, matter, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Cittasampayutt duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Conjoined with consciousness and Disjoined from consciousness

padas.dabbattha: 52 cetasikas
padas.explanation: Mental factors that arise and cease together with consciousness.

padas.dabbattha: 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Matter and Nibbāna, which never associate with mind.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 89 cittas
dukamuttaka.explanation: Citta cannot associate with itself, nor is it classified as cittavippayutta.

dukas.name: Cittasaṃsaṭṭha duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Blended with consciousness and Unblended with consciousness

padas.dabbattha: 52 cetasikas
padas.explanation: Mental factors intimately conjoined and fused with consciousness.

padas.dabbattha: 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Matter and Nibbāna.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 89 cittas
dukamuttaka.explanation: Citta is exempt because it does not blend with itself.

dukas.name: Cittasamuṭṭhāna duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Originated by consciousness and Not originated by consciousness

padas.dabbattha: 52 cetasikas, 17 cittaja rūpas
padas.explanation: Mental factors (originating through citta) and the 17 material qualities born of consciousness.

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, 20 kammaja rūpas, 15 utuja rūpas, 14 āhāraja rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.rupa: 20 kammaja rūpas, 15 utuja rūpas, 14 āhāraja rūpas
padas.explanation: Citta itself, matter generated by causes other than mind, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Cittasahabhū duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Co-existent with consciousness and Not co-existent with consciousness

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, 26 rūpas (excluding 2 viññatti rūpas), Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Citta itself, the other 26 material phenomena, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Cittānuparivattī duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Conforming to consciousness and Not conforming to consciousness

padas.dabbattha: 52 cetasikas, 2 viññatti rūpas
padas.explanation: 52 cetasikas and 2 viññatti rūpas that follow consciousness in arising, staying, and falling away.

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, 26 rūpas (excluding 2 viññatti rūpas), Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Citta itself, remaining rūpas, and Nibbāna.

padas.paliTranslation: States blended with and originated by consciousness
padas.dabbattha: 52 cetasikas
padas.explanation: Only the 52 cetasikas are both originated by and intimately blended with consciousness (matter cannot be blended with citta).

padas.paliTranslation: States not blended with and originated by consciousness
padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Citta itself, all matter, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Cittasaṃsaṭṭha-samuṭṭhāna-sahabhū duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Blended, originated, and co-existent with consciousness vs Not-so

padas.paliTranslation: States blended with, originated by, and co-existent with consciousness
padas.dabbattha: 52 cetasikas
padas.explanation: The 52 cetasikas meet all three criteria.

padas.paliTranslation: States not blended with, originated by, and co-existent with consciousness
padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Citta itself, all matter, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Cittasaṃsaṭṭha-samuṭṭhānānuparivattī duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Blended, originated, and conforming to consciousness vs Not-so

padas.paliTranslation: States blended with, originated by, and conforming to consciousness
padas.dabbattha: 52 cetasikas
padas.explanation: The 52 cetasikas meet all three conditions.

padas.paliTranslation: States not blended with, originated by, and conforming to consciousness

padas.explanation: Citta, all 28 rūpas, and Nibbāna.

padas.rupa: 5 pasāda rūpas (eye, ear, nose, tongue, body sensitivity)
padas.explanation: The 6 internal bases (āyatana): 89 cittas (manāyatana) and 5 sensitive matters.

padas.dabbattha: 52 cetasikas, 23 rūpas (excluding 5 pasāda rūpas)
padas.explanation: All remaining mental concomitants, 23 non-sensitive matters, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Ūpadā duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Derived matter and Non-derived matter

padas.dabbattha: 24 upādāya rūpas
padas.explanation: The 24 material qualities dependent on the 4 great essentials.

padas.dabbattha: 89 Cittas, 52 cetasikas, 4 mahābhūta rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: The 4 primary elements, all mental states, and Nibbāna.

padas.dabbattha: 32 lokiya vipāka cittas, their associated 35 cetasikas, 20 kammaja rūpas
padas.explanation: Results produced directly by past kamma grasped by craving and view.

padas.dabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, 21 kusala cittas, 4 lokuttara phala cittas, 20 kiriyā cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 17 cittaja rūpas, 15 utuja rūpas, 14 āhāraja rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Active kamma, functional cittas, phala cittas, non-kammaja matter, and Nibbāna.

gocchakas.name: Upādāna Gocchaka
gocchakas.description: The cluster of 6 dyads dealing with the 4 clingings (kāmūpādāna, diṭṭhūpādāna, sīlabbatūpādāna, attavādūpādāna) comprising lobha and diṭṭhi.

padas.dabbattha: Lobha, diṭṭhi
padas.explanation: The 4 clingings reduce to lobha (sensual clinging) and diṭṭhi (the other 3 clingings).

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, their associated 50 cetasikas (excluding the 2 upādānas), 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All other dhammas.

padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: All mundane dhammas that can become objects of clinging.

padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Supramundane consciousness, cetasikas, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Upādānasampayutta duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Conjoined with clinging and Disjoined from clinging

padas.dabbattha: 8 lobhamūla cittas, their associated 22 cetasikas (excluding dosādi catukka, vicikicchā, and lobha in the 4 lobhamūla diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas)
padas.cetasikas: 22 cetasikas (excluding dosacattuka, vicikicchā, and solitary lobha in diṭṭhigata-vippayutta cittas)
padas.explanation: States associated with clinging. In the 4 diṭṭhigata-vippayutta cittas, lobha is solitary as an upādāna and cannot associate with itself.

padas.dabbattha: 2 dosamūla cittas, 2 mohamūla cittas, 21 kusala cittas, 36 vipāka cittas, 20 kiriyā cittas, their associated 49 cetasikas (excluding lobha, diṭṭhi and māna), lobha in the 4 lobhamūla diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All other states dissociated from clinging.

padas.paliTranslation: States that are clingings and favourable to clinging
padas.dabbattha: 2 upādānas (lobha and diṭṭhi)
padas.explanation: The 2 clinging cetasikas.

padas.pada: Upādāniyā ceva dhammā no ca upādānā
padas.paliTranslation: States favourable to clinging but not clingings
padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 50 cetasikas (excluding the 2 upādānas), 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: Mundane cittas, remaining cetasikas, and matter.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna

padas.paliTranslation: States that are clingings and associated with clinging
padas.dabbattha: lobha and diṭṭhi in the 4 lobhamūla diṭṭhigata sampayutta cittas
padas.cetasikas: lobha and diṭṭhi in 4 diṭṭhigata-sampayutta cittas
padas.explanation: Lobha and diṭṭhi mutually associate with one another in diṭṭhigata-sampayutta consciousness.

padas.pada: Upādānasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca upādānā
padas.paliTranslation: States associated with clinging but not clingings
padas.dabbattha: 8 lobhamūla cittas, their associated 20 cetasikas (excluding lobha, diṭṭhi, dosādi catukka and vicikicchā)
padas.explanation: Consciousness and non-clinging cetasikas associated with clinging.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 2 dosamūla cittas, 2 mohamūla cittas, 21 kusala cittas, 36 vipāka cittas, 20 kiriyā cittas, their associated 49 cetasikas (excluding lobha, diṭṭhi and māna), lobha in the 4 lobhamūla diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna

padas.paliTranslation: States dissociated from clinging but favourable to clinging
padas.dabbattha: 2 dosamūla cittas, 2 mohamūla cittas, 17 lokiya kusala cittas, 32 lokiya vipāka cittas, 20 kiriyā cittas, their associated 49 cetasikas (excluding lobha, diṭṭhi and māna), lobha in the 4 lobhamūla diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas, 28 rūpas
padas.cetasikas: 49 cetasikas + solitary lobha in diṭṭhigata-vippayutta cittas
padas.explanation: Mundane states dissociated from clinging.

padas.paliTranslation: States dissociated from clinging and not favourable to clinging
padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Supramundane consciousness, cetasikas, and unconditioned Nibbāna.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 8 lobhamūla cittas, their associated 22 cetasikas (excluding dosādi catukka, vicikicchā, and lobha in the 4 lobhamūla diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas)

gocchakas.name: Kilesa Gocchaka
gocchakas.description: The cluster of 8 dyads dealing with the 10 defilements (lobha, dosa, moha, māna, diṭṭhi, vicikicchā, thīna, uddhacca, ahirika, anottappa) and their associations and corruptions.

padas.dabbattha: Lobha, dosa, moha, māna, diṭṭhi, vicikicchā, thīna, uddhacca, ahirika, anottappa
padas.explanation: The 10 mental factors that torment and burn the mind.

padas.dabbattha: 89 cittas, their associated 42 cetasikas (excluding the 10 kilesas), 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All other states besides the 10 defilements.

padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: All mundane dhammas that can become objects of defilement.

padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Supramundane consciousness, cetasikas, and unconditioned Nibbāna.

padas.dabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, their associated 27 cetasikas
padas.explanation: All 12 unwholesome consciousnesses and their 27 unwholesome cetasikas.

padas.dabbattha: 21 kusala cittas, 36 vipāka cittas, 20 kiriyā cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Wholesome, resultant, functional states, matter, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Kilesasampayutta duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Conjoined with defilements and Disjoined from defilements

padas.dabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, their associated 27 cetasikas
padas.explanation: All 12 unwholesome cittas and their 27 associated cetasikas (moha, ahirika, anottappa, uddhacca are present throughout all akusala).

padas.dabbattha: 21 kusala cittas, 36 vipāka cittas, 20 kiriyā cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All remaining states dissociated from defilements.

padas.paliTranslation: States that are defilements and subject to defilements
padas.dabbattha: 10 kilesas (lobha, dosa, moha, māna, diṭṭhi, vicikicchā, thīna, uddhacca, ahirika, anottappa)
padas.explanation: The 10 defilement cetasikas themselves.

padas.pada: Saṃkilesikā ceva dhammā no ca kilesā
padas.paliTranslation: States subject to defilements but not defilements
padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 42 cetasikas (excluding the 10 kilesas), 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: Mundane cittas, remaining cetasikas, and matter.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna

padas.paliTranslation: States that are defilements and defiled
padas.dabbattha: 10 kilesas (lobha, dosa, moha, māna, diṭṭhi, vicikicchā, thīna, uddhacca, ahirika, anottappa)
padas.explanation: The 10 defilement factors themselves.

padas.pada: Saṃkiliṭṭhā ceva dhammā no ca kilesā
padas.paliTranslation: States that are defiled but not defilements
padas.dabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, their associated 17 cetasikas (excluding the 10 kilesas)
padas.explanation: The 12 akusala cittas and non-kilesa unwholesome cetasikas.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 21 kusala cittas, 36 vipāka cittas, 20 kiriyā cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna

padas.paliTranslation: States that are defilements and associated with defilements
padas.dabbattha: 10 kilesas (lobha, dosa, moha, māna, diṭṭhi, vicikicchā, thīna, uddhacca, ahirika, anottappa)
padas.explanation: Each defilement co-arises with at least 3 other universal unwholesome defilements.

padas.pada: Kilesasampayuttā ceva dhammā no ca kilesā
padas.paliTranslation: States associated with defilements but not defilements
padas.dabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, their associated 17 cetasikas (excluding the 10 kilesas)
padas.explanation: The 12 akusala cittas and non-defilement cetasikas.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 21 kusala cittas, 36 vipāka cittas, 20 kiriyā cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna

padas.paliTranslation: States dissociated from defilements but subject to defilements
padas.dabbattha: 17 lokiya kusala cittas, 32 lokiya vipāka cittas, 20 kiriyā cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: Mundane wholesome, resultant, and functional states and matter.

padas.paliTranslation: States dissociated from defilements and not subject to defilements
padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Supramundane consciousness, cetasikas, and unconditioned Nibbāna.

dukamuttaka.fullDabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, their associated 27 cetasikas

gocchakas.name: Piṭṭhi Duka
gocchakas.description: The concluding cluster of 18 supplementary dyads (end dyads) classifying phenomena by eradication through seeing/developing, thought, rapture, feeling, planes of existence, leading out, and conflict.

dukas.name: Dassanena pahātabba duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Eradicated by Seeing (Sotāpatti-magga) vs Not eradicated by Seeing

padas.dabbattha: 4 diṭṭhigata sampayutta cittas, vicikicchā sampayutta citta, their associated 22 cetasikas (excluding māna, dosa, issā, macchariya, kukkucca and the moha in vicikicchā sampayutta citta) that are eradicated by the sotāpatti magga; 4 diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas, 2 dosamūla cittas that can lead to 4 apāya and their associated 25 cetasikas (excluding diṭṭhi and vicikicchā), which are eradicated by the sotāpatti magga
padas.cittas: 4 diṭṭhigata-sampayutta cittas, 1 vicikicchā-sampayutta citta, and apāya-leading portions of 4 diṭṭhigata-vippayutta and 2 dosamūla cittas
padas.cetasikas: Associated unwholesome cetasikas eradicated by stream-entry
padas.explanation: All unwholesome consciousness and cetasikas entirely uprooted by the first supramundane path (sotāpatti-magga).

padas.dabbattha: 4 diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas and 2 dosamūla cittas that do not lead to 4 apāya, uddhacca sampayutta citta, their associated 25 cetasikas (excluding diṭṭhi and vicikicchā), 28 rūpa, Nibbāna
padas.cittas: Non-apāya unwholesome cittas, uddhacca-sampayutta citta, plus wholesome, resultant, functional cittas
padas.explanation: States eradicated by the higher three paths, along with kusala, vipāka, kiriya, rūpa, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Bhāvanāya pahātabba duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Eradicated by Cultivation (higher 3 paths) vs Not eradicated by Cultivation

padas.dabbattha: 4 diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas connected with gross kāmarāga (that does not lead to 4 apāya), 2 dosamūla cittas connected with gross paṭigha (that does not lead to 4 apāya), their associated 25 cetasikas (excluding diṭṭhi and vicikicchā), which are eradicated by the sakadāgāmī magga; 4 diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas connected with subtle kāmarāga, 2 dosamūla cittas connected with subtle paṭigha, their associated 25 cetasikas (excluding diṭṭhi and vicikicchā), which are eradicated by the anāgāmī magga; 4 diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas connected with rūpa rāga and arūpa rāga, uddhacca sampayutta citta, their associated 21 cetasikas (excluding diṭṭhi, dosa, issā, macchariya, kukkucca and vicikicchā), which are eradicated by the arahatta magga
padas.cittas: Non-apāya diṭṭhigata-vippayutta cittas, dosamūla cittas, and uddhacca-sampayutta citta
padas.explanation: The remaining unwholesome states progressively abandoned by Sakadāgāmī, Anāgāmī, and Arahatta paths.

padas.dabbattha: 4 diṭṭhigata sampayutta cittas, vicikicchā sampayutta citta, their associated 22 cetasikas (excluding māna, dosa, issā, macchariya, kukkucca and the moha in vicikicchā sampayutta citta) that are eradicated by the sotāpatti magga; 4 diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas, 2 dosamūla cittas, that can lead to 4 apāya and their associated 25 cetasikas (excluding diṭṭhi and vicikicchā), which are eradicated by the sotāpatti magga; 28 rūpa, Nibbāna
padas.cittas: States eradicated by Sotāpatti-magga, wholesome, resultant, functional cittas
padas.explanation: Defilements abandoned by seeing, non-defiled conditioned states, and unconditioned Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Dassanena pahātabbahetuka duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Having roots eradicated by Seeing vs Not having roots eradicated by Seeing

padas.paliTranslation: States having roots eradicated by seeing
padas.dabbattha: 4 diṭṭhigata sampayutta cittas, vicikicchā sampayutta citta, their associated 22 cetasikas (excluding māna, dosa, issā, macchariya, kukkucca and the moha in vicikicchā sampayutta citta) that are eradicated by the sotāpatti magga; 4 diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas, 2 dosamūla cittas, that can lead to 4 apāya and their associated 25 cetasikas (excluding diṭṭhi and vicikicchā), which are eradicated by the sotāpatti magga
padas.cittas: States eradicated by sotāpatti-magga accompanied by roots
padas.cetasikas: Associated cetasikas (excluding solitary moha in vicikicchā citta)
padas.explanation: States whose companion roots are uprooted by the first path.

padas.paliTranslation: States not having roots eradicated by seeing
padas.dabbattha: 4 diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas and 2 dosamūla cittas that do not lead to 4 apāya, uddhacca sampayutta citta, their associated 25 cetasikas (excluding diṭṭhi and vicikicchā), moha in vicikicchā sampayutta citta, 28 rūpa, Nibbāna
padas.cetasikas: Associated cetasikas + solitary moha in vicikicchā citta
padas.explanation: Solitary moha in vicikicchā-sampayutta citta has no companion root eradicated by seeing, and all other non-sotāpatti-eradicated states.

dukas.name: Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuka duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Having roots eradicated by Cultivation vs Not having roots eradicated by Cultivation

padas.paliTranslation: States having roots eradicated by cultivation
padas.dabbattha: 4 diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas connected with gross kāmarāga (that does not lead to 4 apāya), 2 dosamūla cittas connected with gross paṭigha (that does not lead to 4 apāya), their associated 25 cetasikas (excluding diṭṭhi and vicikicchā), which are eradicated by the sakadāgāmī magga; 4 diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas connected with subtle kāmarāga, 2 dosamūla cittas connected with subtle paṭigha, their associated 25 cetasikas (excluding diṭṭhi and vicikicchā), which are eradicated by the anāgāmī magga; 4 diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas connected with rūpa raga and arūpa rāga, uddhacca sampayutta citta, their associated 21 cetasikas (excluding diṭṭhi, dosa, issā, macchariya, kukkucca, vicikicchā and the moha in uddhacca sampayutta citta), which are eradicated by the arahatta magga
padas.cetasikas: Associated cetasikas (excluding solitary moha in uddhacca citta)
padas.explanation: States possessing companion roots eradicated by the three higher paths.

padas.paliTranslation: States not having roots eradicated by cultivation
padas.dabbattha: 4 diṭṭhigata sampayutta cittas, vicikicchā sampayutta citta, their associated 22 cetasikas (excluding māna, dosa, issā, macchariya, kukkucca and the moha in vicikicchā sampayutta citta) that are eradicated by the sotāpatti magga; 4 diṭṭhigata vippayutta cittas, 2 dosamūla cittas, that can lead to 4 apāya and their associated 25 cetasikas (excluding diṭṭhi and vicikicchā), which are eradicated by the sotāpatti magga; Moha in uddhacca sampayutta citta, 28 rūpa, Nibbāna
padas.cittas: Sotāpatti-eradicated states, wholesome, resultant, and functional states
padas.cetasikas: Associated cetasikas + solitary moha in uddhaccasampayutta citta
padas.explanation: Includes solitary moha in uddhacca citta (which has no companion root eradicated by bhāvanā), sotāpatti-eradicated dhammas, matter, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Savitakka duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Accompanied by initial application vs Unaccompanied by initial application

padas.dabbattha: 55 savitakka cittas, their associated 51 cetasikas (excluding vitakka)
padas.cittas: 55 savitakka cittas (44 kāmāvacara excluding 10 dvi-pañcaviññāṇa + 11 first-jhāna cittas)
padas.explanation: Cittas and associated cetasikas co-arising with vitakka. Vitakka itself is excluded because a factor does not accompany itself.

padas.dabbattha: 66 avitakka cittas, their associated 37 cetasikas (excluding vitakka), 55 vitakka in the 55 savitakka cittas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.cittas: 66 avitakka cittas (10 dvi-pañcaviññāṇa + 56 higher jhāna cittas)
padas.explanation: Higher jhāna cittas, the 10 sense consciousnesses, vitakka itself, matter, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Savicāra duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Accompanied by sustained application vs Unaccompanied by sustained application

padas.dabbattha: 66 savicāra cittas, their associated 51 cetasikas (excluding vicāra)
padas.cittas: 66 savicāra cittas (55 first jhāna & kāmāvacara + 11 second jhāna 5-fold)
padas.explanation: Consciousness and cetasikas co-occurring with vicāra.

padas.dabbattha: 55 avicāra cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas (excluding vitakka and vicāra), 66 vicāra in the 66 savicāra cittas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Consciousness devoid of vicāra, vicāra itself, physical form, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Sappītika duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Accompanied by rapture vs Unaccompanied by rapture

padas.dabbattha: 51 sappītika cittas, their associated 46 cetasikas (excluding pīti, dosa, issā, macchariya, kukkucca and vicikicchā)
padas.cittas: 51 sappītika cittas (18 somanassa kāma + 11 1st jhāna + 11 2nd jhāna + 11 3rd jhāna)
padas.cetasikas: 46 cetasikas (excluding pīti itself and averse/doubt factors)
padas.explanation: States co-arising with pīti.

padas.dabbattha: 70 appītika cittas, their associated 51 cetasikas (excluding pīti), 51 pīti in the 51 sappītika cittas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.cittas: 70 appītika cittas (upekkhā, dosa, and higher jhāna cittas)
padas.explanation: Cittas lacking pīti, pīti itself, matter, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Pītisahagata duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Rapture-accompanied vs Not rapture-accompanied

padas.dabbattha: 51 pītisahagata cittas, their associated 46 cetasikas (excluding pīti, dosa, issā, macchariya, kukkucca and vicikicchā)
padas.explanation: Equivalent in ultimate reality to Sappītikā dhammā.

padas.dabbattha: 70 cittas without pīti, their associated 51 cetasikas (excluding pīti), 51 pīti in the 51 pītisahagata cittas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Equivalent in ultimate reality to Appītikā dhammā.

dukas.name: Sukha sahagata duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Pleasure-accompanied vs Not pleasure-accompanied

padas.dabbattha: 63 sukhasahagata cittas, their associated 46 cetasikas (excluding vedanā, dosa, issā, macchariya, kukkucca and vicikicchā)
padas.explanation: Cittas and associated cetasikas that co-arise with pleasant bodily or mental feeling.

padas.dabbattha: 3 dukhasahagata cittas, 55 adukkhamasukha sahagata cittas, their associated 51 cetasikas (excluding pīti), 63 sukha vedanā in the 63 sukhasahagata cittas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Painful and neutral consciousness, sukha vedanā itself, physical form, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Upekkhāsahagata duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Equanimity-accompanied vs Not equanimity-accompanied

padas.dabbattha: 55 upekkhāsahagata cittas, their associated 46 cetasikas (excluding vedanā, pīti, dosa, issā, macchariya and kukkucca)
padas.explanation: Mental states occurring with neutral feeling (adukkhamasukha vedanā).

padas.dabbattha: 63 sukhasahagata cittas, 3 dukhasahagata cittas, their associated 51 cetasikas (excluding vicikicchā), 55 upekkhā vedanā in the 55 upekkhāsahagata cittas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Pleasant and painful consciousness, upekkhā vedanā itself, matter, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Kāmāvacara duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Sense-sphere and Not sense-sphere

padas.dabbattha: 54 kāmāvacara cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: All phenomena belonging to the sensual plane of existence.

padas.dabbattha: 15 rūpāvacara cittas, 12 arūpāvacara cittas, 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 38 cetasikas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Fine-material, immaterial, and supramundane consciousness, along with Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Rūpāvacara duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Fine-material-sphere and Not fine-material-sphere

padas.dabbattha: 15 rūpāvacara cittas, their associated 35 cetasikas (excluding the 3 viratis)
padas.explanation: Cittas and cetasikas belonging to the fine-material jhana realm.

padas.dabbattha: 54 kāmāvacara cittas, 12 arūpāvacara cittas, 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Sense-sphere, immaterial, and supramundane states, matter, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Arūpāvacara duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Immaterial-sphere and Not immaterial-sphere

padas.dabbattha: 12 arūpāvacara cittas, their associated 30 cetasikas (excluding vitakka, vicāra, pīti, the 3 viratis and the 2 appamaññās)
padas.cetasikas: 30 cetasikas (excluding vitakka, vicāra, pīti, 3 viratis, 2 appamaññās)
padas.explanation: Formless sphere consciousness and associated mental factors.

padas.dabbattha: 54 kāmāvacara cittas, 15 rūpāvacara cittas, 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All other states outside the formless sphere.

dukas.name: Pariyāpanna duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Included (mundane / cyclic) and Unincluded (supramundane)

padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: States comprised within the three realms of cyclic existence.

padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas (excluding appamaññā), Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Supramundane paths, fruitions, and unconditioned Nibbāna, not contained within the cycle.

dukas.name: Niyyānika duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Leading out (to Nibbāna) and Not leading out

padas.dabbattha: 4 lokuttara magga cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas (excluding the 2 appamaññās)
padas.explanation: Only the 4 supramundane Path knowledges decisively lead out of cyclic existence.

padas.paliTranslation: States not leading out of saṃsāra
padas.dabbattha: 85 cittas (excluding the 4 lokuttara magga cittas), their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All other cittas (including phala cittas), cetasikas, matter, and Nibbāna.

dukas.name: Niyata duka
dukas.description: Dyad of Certain in destiny (fixed result) and Uncertain in destiny

padas.dabbattha: 2 dosamūlacittas, their associated 22 cetasikas (excluding pīti, lobha, diṭṭhi, māna and vicikicchā) that arise as the 7th javana while performing 5 heinous deeds; 4 diṭṭhigata sampayutta lobhamūla cittas and their associated 21 cetasikas (excluding māna, dosa, issā, macchariya, kukkucca and vicikicchā) that arise as the 7th javana while descending into fixed wrong views; 4 lokuttara magga cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas (excluding 2 appamaññā)
padas.cittas: 7th javanas of anantariya-kamma and niyata-micchādiṭṭhi, plus 4 magga cittas
padas.explanation: States of unalterable consequence: anantariya-kamma (hell immediately after death), niyata-micchādiṭṭhi (fixed wrong view), and the 4 supramundane paths (yielding immediate fruition).

padas.dabbattha: 85 cittas (excluding 2 dosamūla cittas that arise as the 7th javana while performing 5 heinous deeds, 4 diṭṭhigata sampayutta lobhamūla cittas that arise as the 7th javana while holding fixed wrong views and the 4 magga cittas), their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: All other states whose results or timing are not definitively fixed.

padas.dabbattha: 81 lokiya cittas, their associated 52 cetasikas, 28 rūpas
padas.explanation: All mundane dhammas have supramundane dhammas superior to them.

padas.dabbattha: 8 lokuttara cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas (excluding appamaññā), Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Supramundane cittas, their cetasikas, and unconditioned Nibbāna have nothing superior to them.

dukas.name: Saraṇa duka
dukas.description: Dyad of With conflict (defiled) and Without conflict (peaceful)

padas.dabbattha: 12 akusala cittas, their associated 27 cetasikas
padas.explanation: Unwholesome states bring suffering, torment, and internal strife (raṇa = kilesa).

padas.dabbattha: 21 kusala cittas, 36 vipāka cittas, 20 kiriyā cittas, their associated 36 cetasikas, 28 rūpas, Nibbāna
padas.explanation: Wholesome, resultant, and functional states, matter, and Nibbāna are free from conflict.
